metrics.visualTitle: Importe por año, en las tres monedas

metrics.QueryText:
DEFINE
	VAR __DS0Core = 
		SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
			'Fecha'[Year],
			"Sales_Amount", 'Internet Sales'[Sales Amount],
			"Total_Sales_Currency_Dolar", 'Internet Sales'[Total Sales Currency Dolar],
			"Total_Sales_Currency_Euro", 'Internet Sales'[Total Sales Currency Euro]
		)

	VAR __DS0BodyLimited = 
		SAMPLE(3502, __DS0Core, 'Fecha'[Year], 1)

EVALUATE
	__DS0BodyLimited

ORDER BY
	'Fecha'[Year]

DEFINE
	VAR __DS0Core = 
		SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
			'Product'[English Product Category Name],
			"Sales_Amount", 'Internet Sales'[Sales Amount],
			"Total_Sales_Currency_Dolar", 'Internet Sales'[Total Sales Currency Dolar],
			"Total_Sales_Currency_Euro", 'Internet Sales'[Total Sales Currency Euro]
		)

	VAR __DS0PrimaryWindowed = 
		TOPN(1001, __DS0Core, [Sales_Amount], 0, 'Product'[English Product Category Name], 1)

EVALUATE
	__DS0PrimaryWindowed

ORDER BY
	[Sales_Amount] DESC, 'Product'[English Product Category Name]

EVALUATE
	ROW(
		"Total_Sales_Currency_Dolar", 'Internet Sales'[Total Sales Currency Dolar]
	)

EVALUATE
	ROW(
		"Total_Sales_Currency_Euro", 'Internet Sales'[Total Sales Currency Euro]
	)

DEFINE
	VAR __DS0Core = 
		SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
			ROLLUPADDISSUBTOTAL('Sales Territory'[SalesTerritoryCountry], "IsGrandTotalRowTotal"),
			"Sales_Amount", 'Internet Sales'[Sales Amount],
			"Total_Sales_Currency_Dolar", 'Internet Sales'[Total Sales Currency Dolar],
			"Total_Sales_Currency_Euro", 'Internet Sales'[Total Sales Currency Euro]
		)

	VAR __DS0PrimaryWindowed = 
		TOPN(
			502,
			__DS0Core,
			[IsGrandTotalRowTotal],
			0,
			[Sales_Amount],
			0,
			'Sales Territory'[SalesTerritoryCountry],
			1
		)

EVALUATE
	__DS0PrimaryWindowed

ORDER BY
	[IsGrandTotalRowTotal] DESC,
	[Sales_Amount] DESC,
	'Sales Territory'[SalesTerritoryCountry]

metrics.visualTitle: Los días alrededor del 29 de febrero (día del año 57 a 62)

metrics.QueryText:
DEFINE
	VAR __DS0FilterTable = 
		FILTER(
			KEEPFILTERS(VALUES('Fecha'[Day of Year])),
			AND('Fecha'[Day of Year] >= 57, 'Fecha'[Day of Year] <= 62)
		)

	VAR __DS0Core = 
		SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
			ROLLUPADDISSUBTOTAL('Fecha'[Date], "IsGrandTotalRowTotal"),
			__DS0FilterTable,
			"Ventas", 'Internet Sales'[Ventas],
			"Ventas_AA___SPLY", 'Internet Sales'[Ventas AA · SPLY],
			"Ventas_AA___Offset_día", 'Internet Sales'[Ventas AA · Offset día],
			"Ventas_AA___Calendario", 'Internet Sales'[Ventas AA · Calendario],
			"Ventas_AA___Columna", 'Internet Sales'[Ventas AA · Columna]
		)

	VAR __DS0PrimaryWindowed = 
		TOPN(502, __DS0Core, [IsGrandTotalRowTotal], 0, 'Fecha'[Date], 1)

EVALUATE
	__DS0PrimaryWindowed

ORDER BY
	[IsGrandTotalRowTotal] DESC, 'Fecha'[Date]

DEFINE
	VAR __DS0Core = 
		SUMMARIZECOLUMNS('Fecha entrega'[Month Name Short Complete], "Ventas", 'Internet Sales'[Ventas])

EVALUATE

ORDER BY

	'Sales Territory'[SalesTerritoryCountry]

metrics.visualTitle: Mes del pedido (filas) por mes de entrega (columnas)

metrics.QueryText:
DEFINE
	VAR __DS0Core = 
		SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
			'Fecha'[Month Name Short],
			'Fecha'[Month],
			'Fecha entrega'[Month Name Short Complete],
			"Ventas", 'Internet Sales'[Ventas]
		)

	VAR __DS0PrimaryWindowed = 
		TOPN(
			101,
			SUMMARIZE(__DS0Core, 'Fecha'[Month Name Short], 'Fecha'[Month]),
			'Fecha'[Month],
			1,
			'Fecha'[Month Name Short],
			1
		)

	VAR __DS0SecondaryBase = 
		SUMMARIZE(__DS0Core, 'Fecha entrega'[Month Name Short Complete])

	VAR __DS0Secondary = 
		TOPN(102, __DS0SecondaryBase, 'Fecha entrega'[Month Name Short Complete], 1)

	VAR __DS0BodyLimited = 
		NATURALLEFTOUTERJOIN(
			__DS0PrimaryWindowed,
			SUBSTITUTEWITHINDEX(
				__DS0Core,
				"ColumnIndex",
				__DS0Secondary,
				'Fecha entrega'[Month Name Short Complete],
				ASC
			)
		)

EVALUATE
	GROUPBY(
		__DS0Core,
		"MinVentas", MINX(CURRENTGROUP(), [Ventas]),
		"MaxVentas", MAXX(CURRENTGROUP(), [Ventas])
	)

EVALUATE
	__DS0Secondary

ORDER BY
	'Fecha entrega'[Month Name Short Complete]

EVALUATE
	__DS0BodyLimited

ORDER BY
	'Fecha'[Month], 'Fecha'[Month Name Short], [ColumnIndex]
